headline: The Regions in government: 'Only 500 million for Health, use voucher funds for over-75s'
summary: Massimo Fabi, coordinator of the health commission of the Conference of Regions, said the money cannot come from local authorities and that they are at a breaking point.
why: Health funding allocation between central government and Italian regions determines public spending priorities and budget pressures across the country.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Le Regioni al governo: “Pochi 500 milioni alla Sanità, usare i fondi dei voucher per gli over 75”
